mqZ-10.result: Counterspells within deck +1.58 (z 2.5, below the line), carried by weaker players; good players about 0 (-0.04 / +0.12). No removal weight, consistent with his 'not taken highly'.

mqZ-16.result: Supported in picks: fixer odds x2.2 with 2+ splash cards held (z 22, all skill groups), mostly when the fixer makes the needed colour. Engine already colour-matches fixing to splash cards held. Deck-level not shown.

mqZ-20.result: Post hoc B5 sensitivity: counting Murmuring Volume, landcyclers and Heartwood makers as sources moves the 0-source cost from -5.6 to -10.7 and the 1-source stratum negative; a non-land fixer does not do what a land does. TOKEN_FIX off. Needs held-out confirmation.

mqZ-23.result: Opposite: late gold cards predict the pair open as well as or slightly better than mono (+0.031 [+0.012, +0.051]); placebo shows table-wide flow. No gold discount.

mqZ-24.result: Top-end count is flat: no penalty for 5+ or 7+ expensive cards at equal quality (CIs about +-0.8); the second top-end card is not worth less at deck level.

mqZ-26.result: Conditional removal (Refute Destiny class) is at placebo within deck (+0.62, z 0.9); REMOVAL_SKIP on: it does not count toward the removal floor. Agrees with him.

mqZ-31.result: Null: cheap (1-2) minus 5+ splash card in hand +0.31 [-1.86, +2.48]; rules out a cheap-card shortfall worse than -1.9. MIN_SPLASH_CMC 1 stays.

mqZ-38.result: No evidence for more lands: 18-land decks too few to measure (26 at skill >= 0.60), no LAND_STEPS step up; tapped lands carry no detectable cost (P5 +0.47 [-0.09, +1.03] per land).

mqZ-40.result: Null: 2 vs 1 distinct splash cards +0.37 [-0.67, +1.42], what card quality predicts; no second-card premium above +1.4.

mqZ-46.result: Creature slope +0.05 [-0.09, +0.19] per creature; the creature bounds rest on matching top players only.

mqZ-48.result: Not supported: no saturation at 6+ fixers in picks (good -0.01 [-0.26, +0.24]) or decks (thin: 272 decks).

mqZ-50.result: MAX_SPLASH 2 for FRA (splash cards per deck 2.6 -> 2.1, top players 2.1); agrees with stopping at two Twisted Fates. Copies vs distinct cards not separated.

mqZ-51.result: Removal floor holds on all decks: decks under 6 removal lose about 0.6 points beyond their cards (REMOVAL_SLACK 2). Agrees with his on-colour kill spell pick.

mqZ-52.result: Two-drop count null at deck level (re-checked on all decks); TWO_DROP_SLACK 99, no two-drop target in the builder.

mqZ-53.result: LAND_STEPS: 17 lands, 16 with 1+ landcycler and 1+ dual, 15 with 2+ of each; 16 vs 17 never significantly worse in any landcycler x dual stratum (2+ cyclers +1.17). His 17 + 2 cyclers + 7 nonbasics would be 15 under our rule; he treats the pair as one land, we as two.

mqZ-59.result: As mqZ-52: no two-drop count effect, so cutting surplus two-drops has no deck-level cost or gain beyond the cards.

mqZ-60.result: Splash castability is carried by land sources: one land source restores a single-pip card to its rating, none costs -5.6 per card; counting landcyclers / Murmuring Volume as sources makes it worse (post hoc). SPLASH_LANDS_ONLY on, so our count differs from his 'kind of' sources.

mqZ-61.result: Double-pip splash cards with 2+ sources seen beat on-colour peers (+5.4 FRA, +8.3 TDM), but DP_BOMB_SPLASH allows them only for a set top-10 bomb with 5 sources; cutting a non-bomb GG card (Vinelasher Adept) agrees with the engine.

mqZ-62.result: Same removal floor as mqZ-51: cutting the only on-colour removal spell is penalised by the builder's shape bound.

mqZ-69.result: Not supported: on-colour tapped lands +0.47 [-0.09, +1.03] per card (rules out a cost beyond -0.09); 4+ tapped lands -2.33 [-10.55, +5.89], 35 decks, uninformative.
